title: VisibilityProposalCreateRequest
description: Create a new visibility proposal against an active session. The patch may come from chat-compiled topology intent or bounded UI edits.

requestText.description: Original user request or concise UI action summary.

summary.description: Concise summary for UI banners and chat responses.

expectedBindingHash.description: Binding hash the proposal expects to apply against.

basedOnRevision.description: Session revision the proposal was created against.
